title: Yosemite Falls, California Granite Cliffs - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A scenic black-and-white snapshot capturing the dramatic vertical cascade of Yosemite Falls spilling down the massive granite rock face into Yosemite Valley. The foreground shows wild brush and a clearing along a roadway or meadow, fronted by a dense band of pine and coniferous trees below the towering cliff face. Characterized by its scalloped decorative border, this mid-century print exemplifies the post-World War II American road trip culture and the growing popular appreciation for National Park natural wonders.
